_doc: Field-level ground truth for run 245 (2026-07-21). v2: corrected after an independent blind re-audit surfaced 3 errors the first audit missed (0/Bahrain-Jordan, 3/most-vs-some, 7/sailor-marine). gold: hallucination|clean|borderline. 'hallucination' = confirmed unsupported/contradicted by the story's own sources. 'borderline' = soft overstatement / invented precision (a MISS is not counted against recall and a FLAG is NOT a false positive). 'clean' = must NOT flag (false-positive denominator). type uses FRANK/RAGTruth taxonomy.

hard_positives.claim: 17 killed since its resumption; Iran struck ... Bahrain and Jordan
hard_positives.why: TWO errors: (a) 17 = cumulative war toll (A28/A457), only 3 since resumption (A574/A241); (b) that night Iran hit 'Bahrain and Kuwait' (A5), not Jordan (separate Fri strike, A33).

sources say 'some' (A24 title) / ~'5 per cent of Canadian exports' (A149). 'most' contradicts the source quantifier. MISSED by all 6 reframe runs (only blind audit caught it) -> known reframe blind spot.

hard_positives.claim: replacing Keir Starmer after barely two years in office
hard_positives.why: Starmer tenure length in none of 36 title-only sources.
election is Israel's (A432); contradicts own summary. NOTE: prod HTML already hotfixed to 'Israeli election' post-audit; fixtures preserve the original error for detector scoring.

hard_positives.claim: armed conflict has triggered at least 12 attacks on health facilities
hard_positives.why: A242: attacks 'mostly fueled by skepticism and rumors', not armed conflict.

hard_positives.claim: would mirror US restrictions on advanced chip exports to China, and comes as Chinese AI companies have rapidly expanded global reach
hard_positives.why: sole source is one 12-word headline, no fulltext. Both clauses invented.

borderline.claim: nearly all remaining Saudi export routes would be cut simultaneously
borderline.why: A36: Europe-bound Suez route stays open; only Asia-bound ~2.5M bpd via Bab el-Mandeb.

borderline.claim: a broad range of Canadian imports
borderline.why: softer than headline's 'most' but still in tension with 'some'/~5% of exports.
summary and sources (A17/A278) say 'marine', not 'sailor'. Minor internal inconsistency.

borderline.claim: occurred hours before Wang Yi arrived in Manila
borderline.why: sources support concurrency ('as','just as') but never an 'hours' interval.

borderline.claim: said 'never, never, never' would parties 'put in place by the Yankees' return to power
borderline.why: A156: 'never never never' referred to future elections generally, spoken as a separate line.

borderline.claim: a former defence secretary as chancellor rather than an economist
borderline.why: 'rather than an economist' contrast is unsourced editorial sharpening.
munition type not in any source.

borderline.claim: countries that have come to rely on cheaper Chinese AI infrastructure - particularly in the Global South
borderline.why: interpretive, but the Global South premise has zero grounding (sole source is a bare headline).
